programmeGates.title: The canonical lint gate cannot run
programmeGates.detail: Canonical has eslint ^9.18.0 as a devDependency and a lint script of eslint src/, but no eslint.config.* and no .eslintrc* exists anywhere in the tree, so ESLint 9 exits 2. There is also no lint:ci script and no lint step in CI. The working flat config (147 lines) plus lint:ci/lint:fix/lint:strict exist only on the old feature branch.
programmeGates.requiredAction: Grant the package-manifest/lockfile lease to exactly one loop, port eslint.config.mjs and the lint scripts, then re-measure the warning ceiling on canonical. The old --max-warnings 359 figure was measured against a different file set and must not be adopted unverified.
programmeGates.consequence: Until closed, no loop may assert that lint does not increase the warning budget, because there is no runnable baseline to compare against.

programmeGates.title: Native modules cannot be built on this host

programmeGates.requiredAction: Install with --ignore-scripts and fetch the Electron binary separately. Design SQLite-facing contracts to be unit-testable without a live native binding. Treat CI (MSVC, Node 22) as authoritative for native builds.
